summary: Checkers - the classic board game. Win tournaments or play offline with friends!
description:
Do you remember this board game from your childhood? Checkers (Draughts) – a traditional and inspiring board game that gives you a lot of fun challenging the computer, playing online multiplayer mode with people from all around the world or with a friend offline. Relax and enjoy Checkers Online wherever you are. Checkers or Draughts will help you to learn and practice logical thinking. Multiplayer checkers mode will make the strategic game even more fun! In our app, you can find the following: - Checkers for free - 5 difficulty levels - Checkers Online with multiplayer mode - Checkers online with Blitz mode - Checkers Puzzles - Checkers offline with a friend - Hints and Undo moves - Variety of boards and piece styles - User profile in Checkers online

Checkers Online no registration

Play Checkers Online with other users in just three steps: 1. Create a profile by choosing an avatar, the flag of your country and entering your nickname. 2. Choose the rules you want to play. 3. Start playing and enjoy the Checkers Game. Compare yourself to other users in multiplayer mode, improve your skills and collect gold!

Checkers Puzzles

Looking for brain teasers? Want a fun way to relax and train your brain? Try the “Challenges” mode! Test your skills in exciting checkers endgames with only a few pieces left on the board. Can you find the winning moves? Checkers Puzzles are perfect for both beginners and masters!

Blitz mode - perfect for a break

How to play the new blitz mode? Tap ‘’Online game’’, find the Blitz mode with a time control of 3 minutes + 2 seconds for each move, and play! This draughts mode is faster, more dynamic, and exciting to play.

Tournaments

Try your hand at Blitz ARENA tournaments! Sign up for tournaments in advance by clicking the ''Join'' button, and when the tournament starts, tap ''Play'' and compete! All you have to do is to win as many games as possible and grab royal prizes! You will find your results in the leaderboard of the ongoing tournament.

5 different levels of difficulty

Let's start from the easiest level and check if you can win against the computer. The more experienced you are, the more likely you are to beat our Checkers Master. Take up the Checkers challenge and go through all 5 levels!

Checkers or Draughts variants and rules: online multiplayer and offline mode

There are many ways to play Checkers (Draughts). Everyone has various habits and usually prefers to play exactly the same way as they used to play Checkers in the past. That is why decide on your favorite rules of this game: American Checkers or English Draughts Capturing is mandatory, but the pieces cannot capture backward. The king can only move one square and can move and capture backward. International Draughts Capturing is mandatory and all the pieces can capture backward. The queen (king) has long moves which means that, if the square is not blocked, the queen can move any distance diagonally. Spanish Checkers: Damas Known as Spanish Draughts, based on international rules, but the pieces cannot capture backward. Turkish Checkers: Dama Named also Turkish Draughts. The game is played on both light and dark squares of the checkerboard. Pieces start on the second and third rows of a game board. They do not move diagonally but forward and sideways. The way that the kings (queens) move is similar to the chess queens. Play Checkers and Draughts the way you like the most You can change game settings and choose your own Checkers app rules e.g. backward capture or mandatory capture. Play Checkers online, offline with friends, face 5 levels of the game against the computer or solve checkers puzzles. Have a good game! Best regards, CC Games Team
